Zstandard (facebook/zstd) tag v1.5.7 (tag object ac66b19e6bd6b83238bf008eecc1298105298532), commit f8745da6ff1ad1e7bab384bd1f9d742439278e99. BSD licence (LICENSE; zstd is dual BSD/GPLv2, we use BSD).
Source: https://github.com/facebook/zstd/releases/download/v1.5.7/zstd-1.5.7.tar.gz sha256 eb33e51f49a15e023950cd7825ca74a4a2b43db8354825ac24fc1b7ee09e6fa3.
zstd.c is generated by strip.py from the unpacked tarball: upstream combine.py amalgamation (compressor only: decompress/, dictBuilder/, zstdmt_compress, threading and pool dropped, ZSTD_MULTITHREAD off), every comment replaced by one space (string and character literals skipped), blank lines dropped (kept after a macro continuation), upstream licence header (lib/zstd.h, BSD/GPLv2) prepended verbatim, and one patch: "#define ZSTD_isError mc2z_ZSTD_isError" after the upstream "#undef ZSTD_isError". Reproduce: py -3 -I strip.py <zstd-1.5.7 dir> zstd.c
zstd.h and zstd_errors.h = upstream lib/ files unchanged (licence headers intact).
zstd_prefix.h = generated: llvm-nm -g --defined-only on zstd.c, every external symbol (minus compiler-private @ constants) renamed mc2z_<name>; zstd_mc2.c includes it before zstd.c. Compressor only: never decode with this copy (the engine decodes with basisu/zstd 1.4.9).
